# fundament_projects (Data Source)

Fetches the list of projects for the current organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_cluster" "example" {
  name = "my-cluster"
}

data "fundament_projects" "all" {
  cluster_id = data.fundament_cluster.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The cluster ID to list projects for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `projects` (Attributes List) List of projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster this project belongs to.
- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster this project belongs to.
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the project was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project.
